source_retrieval.repository_sources: git cat-file blob <sourceCodeCommit>:<path>, including vendored Rapier; no worktree source hashes
source_retrieval.external_parry_source: Absolute local reference file, required to match the pinned SHA256
source_retrieval.archives: Four exact closed input hashes checked before reading and again unchanged after analysis

scope: Read-only arithmetic over closed archives and inspection of local source. No physics, FK, new world, Rust tests, third-party execution or network.

coverage.raw_world_branches: two technical pairs only, predicted and actual, initial/frame/post_tick
coverage.nativeRecords_warning: identityBytes is only the byte length, not serialized identity data; it cannot recover the missing world at78.

normal_and_plane_statistics.limits: Filtered positive-impulse contacts only. Full normal vectors and raw separation are absent outside technical raw-world slices. No claim for missing/unselected/zero-impulse points or unavailable intermediate forecast contacts.

At78 the retained left point is outside the loaded same-segment convex hull by approximately69.993mm. This is not an equivalent covering triangle renewal.

The left point geometric position remains below the support floor; its archived-pose instantaneous vertical velocity is about+0.098154m/s. Geometry, normal impulse and material-point identity are separate observables.

In each earlier prefix the same local left corner is loaded at27, missing from loaded contacts at28, and loaded again at29 while the segment remains supported. This proves an earlier transient absence, not that the refused forecast would recover at79.
Raw unselected forefoot points retain positive impulses in technical36..40. They must not be counted as current load or used to fill a support hull.

proposed_rule_not_implemented.material: Keep the original material local coordinate and world anchor immutable, and preserve the10mm tangential drift guard.
proposed_rule_not_implemented.direct_support: An observed selected loaded contact can witness direct support when normal, separation, load and same-body/surface identity are valid.
proposed_rule_not_implemented.regional_support: For an explicitly regional task, optionally accept absence of an exact solver sample only when a nondegenerate same-segment, same-surface loaded triangle covers that unchanged material point, with constrained normal/plane/separation and admissible aggregate support wrench. Do not infer pointwise force from interpolation.
proposed_rule_not_implemented.point_pivot: A task requiring a loaded point pivot is stronger than regional coverage; do not silently reinterpret it.
proposed_rule_not_implemented.negative_or_unknown: Outside hull, separated, contradictory or insufficient evidence must refuse; missing raw evidence must not be relabeled benign renewal.
proposed_rule_not_implemented.this_trace: The conservative regional rule still refuses78; no reanchoring, threshold relaxation or point substitution is justified.

future_observation_requirements: At every substep preserve body/surface handles with generations, subshape and manifold scope, feature IDs and point indices with explicit lifetime semantics.
Record all geometric candidates, selected solver indices/newness flags, zero and positive impulses, current solver-anchor world positions, live normal separation and exclusion reason separately.
Keep per-CCD-interval impulses separate from latest-interval selected contacts and the enclosing240Hz total. Preserve normal/tangent components and current normal.
Log direct-point versus regional support acceptance, barycentric weights, plane residual, hull distance, unchanged anchor drift, load centroid and global support/moment checks.

derived_quantity_definitions.normal_impulse_ns: current_upward_load_n * exact f32 native dt / upward_normal; reconstructs the selected latest-interval scalar, not an enclosing-step total when CCD has multiple intervals.
derived_quantity_definitions.load_centroid: Weighted mean of recorded selected contact positions by upward loads; excludes friction moments and is not a complete resultant wrench.
derived_quantity_definitions.coverage: Convex hull of current loaded contact local XZ coordinates on the same anatomical segment. Plane residual is reported separately. No body/model reconstruction.
derived_quantity_definitions.point_motion: Stored translation/quaternion and linear/angular velocity only: p=t+R*local; v_point=v+omega cross(R*local). No kinematic tree or integration.
